overview_description.description:
Ubiq enables individuals and organizations to give wireless presentations. It offers a modern meeting room solution that allows its users to wirelessly project any content from their tablets or laptops to an existing projector or TV.

The company offers its services to the education and government, financial services, manufacturing, marketing and advertising, retail, hospitality, and technology sectors.

Ubiq was founded in 2015.
